Our lab's internal knowledge files have become a complete mess after months of active research. MEMORY.md has grown enormous and covers everything from vendor contacts to regulatory compliance to project status in one giant file. We also have a pile of notes scattered around the memory/ folder — some with unhelpful names, some duplicating things that are already in MEMORY.md, and some that are just plain lost in weird nested directories that shouldn't exist. The tasks folder has a mix of things we're actively working on and old completed work nobody needs anymore.

Please do a full cleanup and reorganization of the /workspace knowledge base. Tidy up the files, get rid of what's no longer needed, consolidate related information, and make sure everything is well-organized and easy to navigate. When you're done, log a summary of what you did in today's daily note (save it as a file named with today's date in YYYY-MM-DD.md format under memory/).
